meaning: adj. 有生命的 vt. 使有生氣

meaning: adj. 細微的；微妙的；精巧的

meaning: v. 選擇；挑選 adj. 精選的

meaning: adj. 可獲得的；可用的；有空的

meaning: n. 胡椒；胡椒粉 vt. 撒胡椒

meaning: vi. 呻吟；嘆息 n. 呻吟聲

meaning: n. 謹慎；警告 v. 警告

meaning: adj. 金髮碧眼的 n. 金髮女子

meaning: n. 運輸；過境 v. 經過；中轉

meaning: v. 表現；運轉；舉止得體

meaning: adj. 毀滅性的；強有力的

meaning: v. 疏浚；挖掘；重提舊事

meaning: vt. 發射；推出；發起 n. 發射；上市

meaning: v. 褪色；變淡；逐漸消失

meaning: vt. 使恢復正常生活；修復；復職

meaning: n. 形式；表格 v. 形成

meaning: v. 領導；引導；致使 n. 鉛

meaning: n. 數字；人物；身材；圖表 v. 認為；計算

meaning: adj. 多產的；富有成效的

meaning: vi. 回答；響應；作出反應

meaning: adj. 多重的；多樣的 n. 倍數

meaning: n. 花；開花期 v. 開花

meaning: n. 詭計；花招 vt. 欺騙

meaning: adj. 學術的；學院的 n. 學者；大學教師

meaning: n. 生物測定學；生物辨識技術

meaning: n. 光束；梁；笑容 v. 面露喜色；播送

meaning: adj. 令人討厭的；惡劣的；下流的

The annual conference brings together researchers from more than thirty different countries. (年度會議聚集來自三十多個不同國家的研究人員。)
Eating too much fried food can raise your cholesterol and blood pressure. (吃太多油炸食物會提高膽固醇和血壓。)

meaning: n. 小隔間；電話亭；攤位

meaning: v. 減少 n. 減少；減少量

meaning: adj. 道德的 n. 道德；寓意

meaning: adj. 陶器的 n. 陶瓷器

meaning: n. 性格；特性；角色；字元

meaning: adj. 操縱他人的；善於操控的

meaning: n. 十字軍；運動 v. 投身運動

meaning: vt. 嘲笑；譏諷 n. 嘲弄

meaning: v. 處理；操作 n. 把手

meaning: vi. 閃爍 n. 閃光
example: Frost glittered on the grass as the sun rose over the valley. (太陽升上山谷時，霜在草地上閃爍。)
Students receive detailed written feedback on every essay soon after submission, helping them understand exactly where their arguments need strengthening. (學生在交作業後不久就會收到每篇文章的詳細書面回饋，幫助他們確切了解論點哪裡需要加強。)
The first earthquake damaged several old houses, and subsequent tremors forced residents to sleep outdoors for several long weeks. (第一次地震損壞了幾棟老房子，隨後的餘震迫使居民在戶外睡了好幾個漫長星期。)
A shark was spotted near the beach, so swimming was temporarily banned. (有人在海灘附近目擊鯊魚，因此暫時禁止游泳。)
The council introduced new smaller rubbish bins, hoping residents would actually recycle far more of their household waste. (市議會推出更小的新垃圾桶，希望居民真的會回收更多家庭廢棄物。)
The venomous snake is rarely seen, but its bite can be fatal. (這種毒蛇很少被看到，但被咬可能致命。)

meaning: n. 知識分子 adj. 智力的
example: The cafe was a favourite meeting place for artists, writers and political intellectuals. (這家咖啡館曾是藝術家、作家和政治知識分子喜愛的聚會場所。)

meaning: n. 壓力；拉傷 v. 拉緊；扭傷
example: The long hours placed considerable strain on the already tired nursing staff. (漫長工時對原本已疲憊的護理人員造成相當大的壓力。)

meaning: n. 冠軍；第一名 v. 擁護；支持
example: The chef champions seasonal local food, arguing that freshness matters more than expensive imported ingredients. (這位主廚提倡選用當季本地食材，主張新鮮比昂貴的進口食材更重要。)
The charity funds leukaemia research, and its latest campaign has already raised a remarkable amount for new treatments. (這家慈善機構資助白血病研究，其最新活動已為新療法募得可觀款項。)

meaning: n. （某學科的）專門用語；術語
example: Legal terminology in the contract confused the tenants, so a volunteer lawyer explained each clause in plain language. (合約中的法律術語讓房客困惑，因此一位志願律師用白話解釋每一條款。)

meaning: n. 百年紀念 adj. 一百年的
example: The town held a parade to mark the centennial of its founding. (這座小鎮舉行遊行，紀念建鎮一百週年。)

meaning: adj. 地中海（式）的；地中海地區的 n. 地中海；地中海地區
example: They spent a Mediterranean holiday in a small fishing town, eating fresh fish beside the harbour. (他們在一座小漁鎮度過地中海風情的假期，在港邊享用新鮮魚料理。)
The two sisters constantly try to outdo each other, comparing exam results at every family dinner. (兩姊妹不斷想勝過對方，每次家庭晚餐都會比較考試成績。)

meaning: vt. 訓練；訓導 n. 學科；紀律；處分
example: Marathon training demands real discipline, especially on cold winter mornings when staying in a warm bed feels far easier. (馬拉松訓練需要真正的紀律，尤其是在寒冷的冬日早晨，待在暖被窩裡感覺輕鬆多了。)

meaning: adj. 作為結果的；隨之發生的
example: Heavy rain caused flooding and the consequent closure of the main road. (大雨造成淹水，主要道路也因此封閉。)
The university fulfilled its promise to fund full scholarships, although the official announcement came almost a year late. (大學兌現了資助獎學金的承諾，儘管正式公告遲了將近一年。)

meaning: n. 要素；元素；基本原理；組成部分
example: A surprise element is essential to any truly good ghost story, keeping readers uncertain until the final page. (意外要素對任何真正精彩的鬼故事都不可或缺，能讓讀者不確定到最後一頁。)
This segment of the documentary focuses on small fishing families, whose daily lives changed after the harbour closed. (這部紀錄片的這一段聚焦小型漁業家庭，他們的生活在港口關閉後改變。)
The orchestra rehearsed for weeks before the opening night of the opera. (管弦樂團為歌劇首演夜排練了好幾週。)

meaning: n. 肌肉；體力；力量；實力
example: Regular stretching helps prevent painful muscle injuries among very active older runners. (規律伸展有助於預防年長業餘跑者的疼痛肌肉傷害。)

meaning: vi. 執行；起作用 n. 功能；職責；作用；函式
example: The heating system functions well, but the controls are difficult to understand. (暖氣系統運作良好，但控制面板很難理解。)
The overgrown garden works as a metaphor for neglect, slowly swallowing the old family house in the novel. (這座蔓生的花園在小說中象徵疏於照顧，慢慢吞沒那棟老家族宅邸。)

meaning: n. 代表；代表團成員 vt. 委派；授權
example: Delegates from more than thirty countries attended the climate conference in Geneva. (來自三十多個國家的代表出席日內瓦的氣候會議。)

meaning: adj. 脆弱的；虛弱的；易碎的；易受傷害的
example: The peace agreement remains fragile, and small incidents could easily undo it. (和平協議仍然脆弱，小事件就可能輕易破壞它。)

meaning: v. 發光；發熱；輻射；發散
example: The old wood stove radiates enough heat to warm the whole kitchen. (老木爐散發的熱量足以溫暖整個廚房。)

meaning: adj. 位於……的；處於……境地的
example: The new school is badly situated beside a very busy road, so playground noise is a constant concern. (新學校位置緊鄰一條非常繁忙的道路，因此遊樂場噪音成了持續的隱憂。)
Gardeners often release ladybirds to control common invaders such as harmful aphids, reducing the need for chemical sprays. (園丁常放出瓢蟲控制蚜蟲等有害的常見入侵者，減少對化學噴劑的需求。)

meaning: adj. 徹底的；完成的 vt. 完成；結束
example: The room fell into complete silence when the stranger mentioned the missing letter. (陌生人提起那封失蹤的信時，房間裡頓時一片寂靜。)

meaning: n. 成套工具 v. 裝備
example: Every new bicycle comes with a basic repair kit and a pump. (每輛新腳踏車都附基本維修工具組和打氣筒。)

meaning: vt. 產生（光熱電等）；引起；導致
example: Solar panels on the roof generate enough electricity to run the office. (屋頂的太陽能板發電量足以供應辦公室用電。)

meaning: adj. 遙遠的；偏僻的；疏遠的；微乎其微的
example: The small remote island has no doctor, so residents rely on a monthly boat clinic and radio advice. (這座偏遠小島沒有醫生，因此居民依靠每月一次的船上診所和無線電建議。)
A large pot of vegetable soup was simmering on the wood stove. (一大鍋湯在木爐上小火慢煮。)
Surgeons use a simple checklist to avoid common careless mistakes, especially during long routine operations late at night. (外科醫師用簡單檢查表避免常見的粗心錯誤，尤其是在深夜的長時間例行手術中。)

meaning: v. 解僱；解散；駁回；不受理
example: The club dismissed the coach after one disappointing season, despite his continuing popularity among younger local players. (球團在一個令人失望的球季後解僱教練，儘管他在當地年輕球員之間仍很受歡迎。)
They filled a bucket with warm soapy water and washed the car. (他們把水桶裝滿溫肥皂水，然後洗車。)
An owl nested in the barn and hunted mice across the fields. (一隻貓頭鷹在穀倉築巢，在田野間捕鼠。)
High absenteeism during the winter flu season forced the school to combine several classes for almost two weeks. (冬季流感季期間曠課率偏高，迫使學校將幾個班級合併上課將近兩週。)
The apparent similarity between the twins hides very different personalities, as their new teachers quickly discovered. (這對雙胞胎表面上的相似掩蓋了截然不同的個性，新老師很快就發現了這點。)
Many tender young plants succumbed to the unexpected overnight frost, leaving the small vegetable garden almost completely bare. (許多柔嫩的幼苗不敵突如其來的隔夜霜害，讓小菜園幾乎完全光禿。)

meaning: v. 伸展；延伸；拉長 n. 一段（時間或路徑）
example: We walked a long stretch of the coastal path without seeing anyone. (我們沿著海岸步道走了好長一段，一個人都沒遇到。)

meaning: n. 部長；外交使節；牧師
example: The health minister promised shorter waiting times, yet many local hospitals still report chronic staff shortages. (衛生部長承諾縮短等候時間，但許多當地醫院仍通報長期人力短缺。)
Incomplete combustion in the old wood stove produced thick smoke, filling the cottage within minutes. (舊木爐燃燒不完全，產生濃煙，幾分鐘內便瀰漫整間小屋。)
She qualified as a veterinary surgeon last year and now works in a busy rural practice. (她去年取得獸醫資格，現在在一家繁忙的鄉村診所工作。)

meaning: adj. 似有道理的；貌似真實的；嘴巧的
example: She offered a plausible explanation, but the details did not quite match. (她提出一個似有道理的解釋，但細節不太對得上。)
The diagrams help elucidate how the machine moves water uphill without fuel. (這些圖有助於闡明這部機器如何在沒有燃料的情況下把水往上送。)

meaning: adj. 短暫的；轉瞬即逝的 n. 短暫停留或工作的人
example: The benefits of the tax cut may prove transient rather than lasting. (減稅的好處可能只是短暫的，而非長久。)
Poor sanitation in crowded refugee camps increases the risk of serious disease. (擁擠的難民營衛生設施差，增加了嚴重疾病的風險。)

meaning: n. 扭曲；變形；曲解；歪曲
example: The map's distortion makes the island look much larger than it is. (地圖的扭曲讓這座島看起來比實際大得多。)

meaning: adj. 無私的；為他人著想的
example: Her decision to donate the entire prize money seemed genuinely altruistic rather than strategic. (她決定把全部獎金捐出去，看起來是真心無私，而非策略考量。)
Climatic conditions here make it difficult to grow wheat without artificial irrigation. (這裡的氣候條件使得沒有人工灌溉就很難種小麥。)

meaning: adj. 務實的；實事求是的；實用主義的
example: We need a pragmatic approach that balances cost, safety and public expectations. (我們需要務實的做法，在成本、安全和公眾期待之間取得平衡。)
Local fish stocks have dwindled sharply as demand for seafood has grown. (隨著海鮮需求增加，當地魚群數量急劇減少。)
She looked at the cheap plastic handbag on the table with undisguised disdain. (她帶著毫不掩飾的鄙視，看著那個便宜的塑膠仿製品。)

meaning: n. 成分；要素；選民 adj. 組成的
example: Protein is a key constituent of every cell in the human body. (蛋白質是人體每個細胞的重要成分。)

meaning: n. 推動；促進；刺激；推動力
example: The new report has given fresh impetus to the campaign for cleaner air. (這份新報告為爭取更乾淨空氣的運動注入新的動力。)
Young children's minds are remarkably malleable, for better and for worse. (幼童的心智可塑性很高，可能帶來好處，也可能造成不利影響。)

meaning: n. （歐洲14至16世紀的）文藝復興；文藝復興時期；復興
example: The old city has experienced a cultural renaissance since the museum reopened. (自從博物館重新開放後，這座老城經歷了一場文化復興。)

meaning: n. 不和諧；不相稱；不協調的事物
example: The incongruity of a luxury car outside the food bank was striking. (食品銀行外停著一輛豪華轎車，這種不協調格外醒目。)
Her instinctual reaction was to shield the child from the falling glass. (她的本能反應是保護孩子，不讓掉落的玻璃傷到他。)
The young racehorse has an impressive pedigree and attracted several wealthy buyers. (這匹年輕賽馬血統優良，吸引了幾位富有買家。)
A brief scuffle broke out between rival fans near the stadium entrance. (敵對球迷在體育場入口附近爆發短暫扭打。)
He wrote a lengthy treatise on the causes of urban poverty in Europe. (他寫了一篇長篇專著，探討歐洲都市貧窮的成因。)

meaning: adj. 假設的；假定的；愛猜想的
example: The teacher posed a hypothetical question about rationing clean water in cities. (老師提出一個假設性問題：城市該如何配給乾淨的水。)

meaning: v. 厚厚地覆蓋；（使）窒息；悶熄（火）
example: He smothered the chips in salt, ignoring his doctor's repeated warnings about high blood pressure. (他在薯條上撒了大量鹽，無視醫師多次提醒他注意高血壓。)

meaning: n. 超越；過量 adj. 過量的；額外的
example: Excess plastic packaging fills household bins quickly, so several local supermarkets now offer refill stations for dry staples. (過量的塑膠包裝很快塞滿家用垃圾桶，因此幾家當地超市現在為乾貨提供補充站。)

meaning: n. 脊椎；脊柱；（動植物的）刺；書脊
example: She injured her spine in a fall and needed months of physiotherapy. (她跌倒傷到脊椎，需要好幾個月的物理治療。)

meaning: n. 壓力；重音；強調 vt. 強調
example: Serious exam stress often disrupts students' sleep, which can make concentration even harder the following week. (嚴重的考試壓力常會擾亂學生睡眠，讓他們隔週更難集中精神。)

meaning: adj. 光滑的；順利的；流暢的；平穩的
example: The product launch was surprisingly smooth, although the marketing team had already changed the date three separate times. (產品發表會出乎意料地順利，儘管行銷團隊已把日期改過三次。)
Tenants may incur unnecessary repair costs if damage results from careless use, according to the new lease. (根據新租約，如果損壞是因使用不慎造成，房客可能得支付不必要的修繕費。)

meaning: n. 發射物；飛彈；投擲物
example: The museum displays a decommissioned missile, reminding local visitors how close the whole region once came to war. (博物館展出一枚除役飛彈，提醒當地訪客整個地區曾多麼接近戰爭。)
He gambled compulsively for years, accumulating large debts that eventually forced his family to sell their own house. (他多年禁不住地賭博，累積龐大債務，最終迫使家人賣掉自己的房子。)

meaning: v. 包；裹；纏繞 n. 披肩
example: Wrap each glass in newspaper before placing them in the cardboard box. (把每個玻璃杯用報紙包起來，再放進紙箱。)

meaning: vt. 限制；管制；禁閉 n. 範圍
example: A severe chest illness confined her to bed for almost three weeks. (一場嚴重的胸腔疾病讓她臥床將近三週。)
A serious limitation of the small camera is its poor performance in low light, especially indoors. (這台小相機的一項重大限制，是在低光源環境下表現不佳，尤其是在室內。)

meaning: n. 鏈條；一連串；連鎖店 vt. 用鏈條拴住
example: The supermarket chain plans to open ten new stores in smaller towns. (這家連鎖超市計畫在小城鎮開十家新店。)
She sipped her hot tea slowly while quietly reading the morning newspaper. (她慢慢啜飲熱茶，同時靜靜讀著晨報。)

meaning: adj. 冗長乏味的；單調的
example: The job involves tedious data entry for several hours every day. (這份工作每天都得花好幾個小時輸入枯燥乏味的資料。)
Modern advances in pathology have improved cancer diagnosis, allowing doctors to choose far more effective treatments much earlier. (現代病理學的進展改善了癌症診斷，讓醫師能更早選擇遠更有效的療法。)
According to a recent study on waiting rooms, a calm hospital setting helps anxious children feel safer. (近期一項候診室研究指出，平靜的醫院環境能讓焦慮的孩子感到更安心。)
Upbeat music in the office lifted the whole staff team's mood, especially during the long dull winter months. (辦公室裡的輕快音樂提振了員工的情緒，尤其是在漫長的冬季。)
The language is almost extinct, with only a handful of elderly speakers still living in the remote valley. (這種語言幾乎已滅絕，只剩少數幾位年長者仍住在偏遠山谷裡使用。)
The aridity of the region makes farming possible only near the river. (這個地區的乾旱使得只能在河邊務農。)

meaning: n. 想像力；視力；視覺；幻覺
example: The architect's vision for affordable housing impressed the panel, although the budget remains far from secure. (建築師對平價住宅的構想讓評審印象深刻，儘管預算仍遠未穩妥。)
The Saturday market sells sausages made from local pork and fresh herbs. (週六市場賣用當地豬肉和新鮮香草製成的香腸。)
Every living organism depends on clean water, sunlight and a stable temperature. (每個生物都需要乾淨的水、陽光和穩定的溫度。)
Constant surveillance in the workplace may reduce trust between staff and managers. (職場持續監視可能降低員工與主管之間的信任。)

meaning: adj. 資格較老的；年長的 n. 較年長者；畢業班學生
example: Senior managers were asked to explain the sudden decision to their teams. (資深經理被要求向團隊解釋這項突然的決定。)
His answer was so vague that nobody understood what he actually planned. (他的回答太模糊，沒有人聽懂他到底打算什麼。)
The heavy investment did not translate into clear profit, and the company closed two factories within a year. (大筆投資並未轉化為明顯利潤，公司在一年內關閉了兩座工廠。)
Growing up in poverty can affect a child's long-term health and education. (在貧窮中長大可能影響孩子長期的健康和教育。)
The old breakwater was badly damaged last winter, leaving the harbour exposed to strong easterly winds. (舊防波堤去年冬天嚴重受損，使港口暴露在強勁的東風中。)

meaning: vt. 更改；修改；（語法上）修飾
example: Engineers modified the design after tests showed the bridge could vibrate badly. (測試顯示橋樑可能劇烈震動後，工程師修改了設計。)

meaning: adj. 順時針方向的；adv. 順時針方向地
example: Turn the metal handle slowly clockwise until the water stops dripping completely. (慢慢順時針轉動金屬把手，直到水完全停止滴漏。)

meaning: vt. 使隔離；使孤立；使脫離
example: The flood isolated several remote villages for days, so rescue helicopters delivered food and medical supplies to stranded families. (洪水使幾個偏遠村莊對外隔絕數日，因此救援直升機運送食物和醫療用品給受困家庭。)

meaning: vt. 強調；突出；集中注意力於 n. 最精彩的部分
example: The report highlights the urgent need for better training in rural clinics. (報告強調偏鄉診所迫切需要更好的訓練。)
Keep the soil moist but not wet while the seeds are growing. (種子生長期間，保持土壤溼潤但不要積水。)

meaning: v. 威脅；恐嚇；預示（危險）來臨；可能發生
example: Rising sea levels threaten low-lying islands and many coastal communities around the world. (海平面上升威脅低窪島嶼和世界各地許多沿海社區。)
The senior manager blamed his underlings for the failed project, although he had approved every major decision himself. (資深經理把專案失敗歸咎於下屬，儘管每一項重大決定都是他自己批准的。)

meaning: n. 媒介；手段 adj. 中等的；平均的
example: Television remains a powerful medium for reaching older audiences who rarely use the internet. (電視仍是觸及很少上網的年長觀眾的強大媒介。)

meaning: n. 細節；詳情；瑣事 vt. 詳述
example: The contract is long, but the important details are on page three. (合約很長，但重要細節在第三頁。)
The agency compiles detailed monthly figures on rents, wages and local employment. (該機構每月彙編關於租金、薪資和就業的詳細數據。)
The school's induction programme pairs new teachers with experienced mentors, helping them settle during their first busy term. (學校的就職輔導計畫讓新教師與資深導師配對，幫助他們在第一個繁忙學期安頓下來。)

meaning: n. 環節；紐帶 v. 連接；聯絡
example: The study found a clear link between diet and heart disease, strengthening calls for better food labelling. (研究發現飲食和心臟病有明確關聯，進一步支持改善食品標示的訴求。)
The grassy foreland provides important natural nesting ground for many seabirds, away from foxes and other mainland predators. (這片長草的岬角為海鳥提供重要的天然築巢地，遠離狐狸和其他陸地掠食者。)
Unemployment among young people rose sharply after the largest local factory closed. (最大的當地工廠關閉後，年輕人失業率急劇上升。)

meaning: n. 選擇（權）；選擇的物（或人）；選課

The small village hall hosts a weekly indoor market, where local farmers sell fresh vegetables and homemade jam. (小型村莊活動中心每週舉辦室內市集，當地農民在那裡販售新鮮蔬菜和自製果醬。)

meaning: n. （大學的）研究班；研討會；討論課
example: The writing seminar helped doctoral students sharpen their arguments before submitting several papers to highly prestigious academic journals. (寫作研討會幫助博士生在投稿到知名學術期刊前磨利論點。)
They lit a small charcoal barbecue in the garden, filling the warm summer evening air with drifting smoke. (他們在花園點起小型木炭烤肉爐，讓溫暖夏夜的空中飄滿煙。)

meaning: adj. 可通航的；適於航行的
example: The canal is navigable for small boats, although many narrow low bridges force taller vessels to turn back. (這條運河可供小船通航，儘管許多低矮窄橋迫使較高的船隻折返。)

meaning: adj. 發臭的；骯髒的；邪惡的 n. 犯規
example: The referee sent the player off for a late foul tackle, sparking loud protests from the home crowd. (裁判因一次遲來的犯規鏟球把球員罰下場，引發主場觀眾大聲抗議。)
The school's track and field competition continued despite heavy rain, leaving several athletes cold, muddy but still cheerful. (儘管大雨，學校的田徑比賽仍繼續進行，幾名選手雖然又冷又髒，卻依然愉快。)

meaning: v. 思量；深思；注視；打算
example: He sat on the balcony to contemplate whether to accept the job offer. (他坐在陽台思量是否接受這份工作。)

meaning: n. 預算；預算經費 v. 做預算
example: The family kept to a strict holiday budget, cooking most meals themselves and avoiding expensive tourist restaurants. (這家人嚴格遵守度假預算，大多數餐點都自己料理，也避開昂貴的觀光餐廳。)
Thousands of residents had to flee their homes when the volcano erupted. (火山爆發時，數千名居民不得不逃離家園。)

meaning: adj. 值得花費時間（或金錢）的；值得做的
example: Although the course was demanding, most students found it a worthwhile investment of time. (雖然這門課要求很高，多數學生仍覺得值得投入時間。)

meaning: v. （用夾具等）夾緊 n. 夾鉗
example: Workers clamp the metal sheets tightly together before welding them into place. (工人先把金屬板緊緊夾住，再焊接固定。)
Online banking offers great convenience, but users must still protect their passwords carefully. (網路銀行很方便，但使用者仍須小心保護密碼。)
Children threw coins into the fountain and made wishes before going home. (孩子們把硬幣丟進噴泉許願，然後回家。)
Many migrant workers send part of their wages home to support their families. (許多移工把部分薪水寄回家鄉養家。)
The contract should clearly specify who is responsible for repairs and insurance. (合約應清楚說明誰負責維修和保險。)
The school treats minor deviance, such as unpolished shoes, as a serious matter, which surprises many new pupils. (學校把鞋子沒擦亮這類輕微偏差行為當成嚴重問題，讓許多新生感到驚訝。)

meaning: v. 估計；估量；評價 n. 估計
example: Engineers estimate the final renovation will cost far more than the council originally promised voters. (工程師估計，最後的整修費用將遠高於地方議會原先向選民承諾的金額。)

meaning: v. 用記號勾出；打核對號
example: Please tick off each item on the list as you pack the boxes. (打包箱子時，請在清單上逐項打勾。)
Tourism now provides a livelihood for most families, although winter visitors remain few and spending is modest. (觀光如今是大多數家庭的生計來源，但冬季遊客仍少，消費也不高。)

meaning: vt. 大量製造；成批生產 n. 大量製造；工業品
example: The company manufactures bicycle parts and exports them to more than twenty countries. (這家公司大量製造自行車零件，外銷到二十多個國家。)
The league voted to censure the coach for rude comments, although many fans thought a fine was enough. (聯盟表決譴責教練的無禮言論，儘管許多球迷認為罰款就夠了。)
A sudden change in voltage damaged several computers and printers in the office. (電壓突然改變，損壞了辦公室裡好幾台電腦和印表機。)
The argument sounds convincing, but its logic breaks down under close examination. (這個論點聽起來有說服力，但仔細檢視後其邏輯就站不住腳。)
A sudden metro strike stranded thousands of commuters, forcing many to walk or queue for crowded buses. (地鐵突然罷工使數千名通勤者受困，許多人只好步行或排隊搭擁擠的公車。)

meaning: v. 入學；登記；加入；招收
example: Parents rushed to enroll their children in the popular swimming course, filling every place within a single morning. (家長爭相為孩子報名這門熱門游泳課，一個早上就把所有名額填滿。)
Ancient civilizations left behind temples, tools and written records that still puzzle historians. (古代文明留下寺廟、工具和文字紀錄，至今仍令歷史學家困惑。)

meaning: n. 彙編；概要（集結某領域資料的書）
example: The guide is a useful compendium of local birds, insects and wild flowers, illustrated with clear colourful photographs. (這本指南是當地鳥類、昆蟲和野花的實用彙編，附有清晰的彩色照片。)
After graduation, she embarked on a demanding career in environmental journalism abroad. (畢業後，她投身海外環境新聞這份要求很高的工作。)
The young team deserved victory after such a brave performance, yet they lost on a single last-minute penalty. (這支年輕球隊在如此勇敢的表現後值得勝利，但他們卻因一個最後時刻的十二碼球落敗。)
The machine ejects the finished metal parts onto a conveyor belt below. (機器把完成的金屬零件彈落到下方的輸送帶上。)
Online banks require a second verification step before transferring large sums of money. (網路銀行在轉帳大筆金額前，要求進行第二道確認程序。)
In autoimmune diseases, the body's defences mistakenly attack its own healthy tissue. (在自體免疫疾病中，身體的防禦機制會誤攻擊自身健康組織。)
She used her inheritance to open a small bakery near the station. (她用繼承來的遺產在車站附近開了一間小麵包店。)
The relentless heat forced farmers to water their crops twice a day. (無情的酷熱迫使農民每天給作物澆兩次水。)

meaning: adj. 需要的；必要的 n. 必需品；要素
example: Applicants must have the requisite skills and at least two years of experience. (申請者必須具備必要技能，以及至少兩年經驗。)
She felt dizziness after standing up too quickly and had to sit down. (她站起來太快感到頭昏眼花，只好坐下來。)

meaning: n. 不重要的部分；外圍
example: The factory stands on the periphery of the city, beside the motorway. (這座工廠位於城市外圍，就在高速公路旁。)

meaning: n. 證明書；資格證書；證件
example: The school checks every teacher's credentials before allowing them to enter a classroom. (學校會查核每位教師的資格，才讓他們進入教室。)
The library keeps a facsimile of the original map in a glass case. (圖書館把原版地圖的複製品放在玻璃櫃中保存。)

meaning: n. 卷軸；捲筒 v. 蹣跚；眩暈
example: He bought a reel of strong wire to repair the garden fence. (他買了一捲結實的鐵絲來修花園圍籬。)

meaning: n. 攪乳器 v. 攪拌；劇烈攪動；反胃
example: The machine churns milk, sugar and ice into a smooth, cold dessert. (這台機器把牛奶、糖和冰攪拌成滑順的冷甜點。)

meaning: adj. 夜晚的；夜間活動的
example: Owls and bats are nocturnal animals that hunt after sunset. (貓頭鷹和蝙蝠都是夜行性動物，會在日落後出來覓食。)

meaning: v. 妨礙；阻止；阻塞；截斷
example: Fallen trees obstruct the mountain road, so rescue teams cannot reach the village. (倒下的樹木阻塞山路，因此救援隊無法抵達村莊。)

meaning: adj. 禁止的；抑制的；令人望而卻步的
example: The cost of housing in the city centre is prohibitive for young families. (市中心的住房成本對年輕家庭來說高得令人望而卻步。)

meaning: n. 航行；航海；航空；導航
example: Poor visibility made navigation difficult, and the ship slowed near the reef. (能見度差使航行困難，船在暗礁附近減速。)
Thick green vines entwine the old stone walls of the abandoned garden. (濃密的綠色藤蔓纏住廢棄花園的舊石牆。)

meaning: adj. 紀念碑的；不朽的；有重大意義的
example: The discovery was a monumental step towards understanding how cells repair themselves. (這項發現是理解細胞如何自我修復的重大一步。)
The coach reiterated the safety rules before the team entered the water. (教練在隊伍下水前重申安全規則。)
Cutting the research budget could jeopardise the success of the whole project. (削減研究預算可能危害整個計畫的成功。)

meaning: adj. 外圍的；次要的 n. 外圍裝置
example: The new road runs through a peripheral part of town, away from the shops. (新道路經過城鎮外圍，遠離商店。)

meaning: adj. 難懂的；難捉摸的；易忘的
example: The exact cause of the illness remains elusive despite years of research. (儘管研究多年，這種疾病確切的病因仍難以捉摸。)
The local bread has a distinctive nutty flavour, produced by slowly roasting the flour before baking. (這種當地麵包有獨特的堅果香氣，是烘焙前慢慢烘烤麵粉所產生的風味。)
The hospital board approved the budget cuts despite objections from senior nurses and doctors. (醫院委員會通過了預算刪減，儘管資深護理師和醫師都表示反對。)
Divers must ascend slowly and stop for decompression to avoid harmful bubbles in the blood. (潛水員必須慢慢上升，並停下來減壓，以免血液中形成有害氣泡。)
The belief that breakfast is essential remains prevalent despite increasingly mixed evidence. (儘管證據越來越分歧，「早餐不可或缺」的觀念仍很普遍。)

meaning: v. 纏繞；捻；扭曲 n. 彎曲
example: She badly twisted her ankle on the uneven path, and had to slowly hobble back to the car. (她在不平的小徑上嚴重扭傷腳踝，只好慢慢一拐一拐地走回車上。)

meaning: v. 租借；出租 n. 租金
example: They rented a small old boat for the afternoon and rowed slowly around the calm lake. (他們租了一艘小舊船，下午慢慢划著船繞平靜的湖一圈。)
An eminent climate scientist warned that coastal cities must adapt much faster than they currently are. (一位傑出的氣候科學家警告，沿海城市必須比目前更快採取調適措施。)

meaning: n. 新月；月牙；新月形物 adj. 新月形的
example: The bakery sells freshly baked crescent rolls every morning, and they are usually gone before nine. (這家麵包店每天早上販售新鮮出爐的牛角麵包，通常九點前就賣光了。)
The octopus uses each sucker to grip rocks and sense nearby prey. (章魚用每個吸盤抓住岩石，並感應附近的獵物。)

meaning: adj. 鎮靜的；平靜的 v. （使）平靜；（使）鎮靜
example: Her calm voice reassured the nervous passengers during the brief but violent turbulence. (在短暫而劇烈的亂流期間，她鎮靜的聲音安撫了緊張的乘客。)

meaning: n. 眼界；見識；範圍；機會
example: The telescope's scope is limited by light pollution in cities, so astronomers travel to remote hills for clearer views. (望遠鏡的觀測範圍受城市光害限制，因此天文學家會前往偏遠山區尋找更清晰的視野。)
Local charities cooperate with schools to provide free meals during the summer holidays. (當地慈善機構與學校合作，在暑假期間提供免費餐點。)
The audience applauded for several minutes after the young pianist finished her performance. (年輕鋼琴家演奏結束後，觀眾鼓掌了好幾分鐘。)
Staff receive a written appraisal of their work at the end of each year. (員工每年年底會收到一份工作表現的書面評估。)
The monthly allowance helps low-income students pay for transport, meals and books. (每月津貼幫助低收入學生支付交通、餐費和書籍費用。)
The old man left his farm to his only heir, a niece in Canada. (這位老人把農場留給他唯一的繼承人，也就是在加拿大的姪女。)

meaning: vt. 剝削；開發；利用 n. 功績
example: Some websites unfairly exploit children's love of games, often encouraging them to spend large sums without parental permission. (有些網站不公平地利用孩子對遊戲的喜愛，常鼓勵他們未經父母同意就花大筆錢。)

meaning: adj. 本國的；家庭的；馴養的
example: Domestic tourism grew sharply last year when international flights became too expensive. (去年國際航班變得太貴時，國內旅遊大幅成長。)
An unexpected delay at the airport forced us to miss the last train. (機場意外延誤，害我們錯過末班火車。)

meaning: n. 律師；建議；忠告 v. 勸告
example: She sought legal counsel before signing the three-year rental agreement. (她在簽三年租約前先徵詢法律意見。)

meaning: adj. 黏性的；（天氣）溼熱的
example: The kitchen floor felt sticky because someone had spilled fruit juice there. (廚房地板摸起來黏黏的，因為有人在那裡打翻果汁。)
Fierce competition at the flower show pushed gardeners to breed increasingly unusual roses, fascinating visitors. (花展競爭激烈，促使園藝家培育愈來愈特別的玫瑰，令參觀者著迷。)

meaning: adj. 有責任感的；可靠的
example: The responsible journalist checked every fact twice before publishing the story about the old factory. (這位負責任的記者在刊登老工廠的報導前，將每項事實查證兩次。)

meaning: n. 批評家；愛挑剔的人
example: The food critic praised the soup but complained about the slow service. (美食評論家稱讚那碗湯，卻抱怨服務太慢。)

meaning: adj. 廣大的；廣闊的；廣泛的
example: The flood caused extensive damage to roads, bridges and hundreds of homes. (洪水對道路、橋梁和數百戶住家造成廣泛破壞。)
A narrow corridor connects the library to the science building next door. (一條狹窄走廊連接圖書館與隔壁的科學大樓。)
It is difficult to imagine modern city life without cars, yet planners believe it is entirely possible. (很難想像沒有汽車的現代城市生活，但規劃者認為這完全辦得到。)

meaning: vi. 相互作用；相互影響
example: Young children learn social skills when they interact with others in group activities. (幼童在團體活動中與他人互動時學習社交技巧。)
Athletes often eat starchy food before a race because it provides steady energy that lasts for hours. (運動員常在比賽前吃含澱粉的食物，因為它能提供持續數小時的穩定能量。)

meaning: adj. 無價值的；瑣屑的；平庸的；普通的
example: A seemingly trivial mistake in the contract cost the company its most important overseas client. (合約中一個看似微不足道的錯誤，讓公司失去最重要的海外客戶。)
Tourists often pay exorbitant prices for simple meals near the main square. (遊客常在主廣場附近為簡單餐點支付不合理的高價。)

meaning: adj. 大規模的；大範圍的
example: The large-scale evacuation began at dawn as floodwater moved towards several low-lying villages. (洪水朝幾個低窪村莊逼近，大規模撤離行動於黎明開始。)
The region now produces excellent wine, attracting tourists who stay in small family-run guesthouses. (這個地區如今出產優質葡萄酒，吸引遊客入住小型家庭經營的民宿。)

meaning: v. （使）輪流；（使）交替 adj. 輪流的；間隔的
example: Patients alternate between rest and gentle exercise during the four-week recovery programme. (在為期四週的復原計畫中，病人輪流休息和做溫和運動。)

meaning: v. 引導；駕駛；掌舵；操縱
example: The guide steered the group away from the flooded path and toward higher ground. (嚮導引導一行人離開淹水的步道，往地勢較高處走。)

meaning: vi. 討價還價 n. 協議；交易；便宜貨
example: In the old market, shoppers bargain politely and often walk away with a discount. (在舊市場裡，購物者客氣地討價還價，往往能帶著折扣離開。)
Washing your hands regularly reduces the risk of infection during the winter months. (勤洗手可降低冬季感染的風險。)

meaning: adj. 保守的；傳統的；守舊的 n. 保守的人
example: Her conservative parents opposed the idea of her travelling alone at night. (她保守的父母反對她夜間獨自旅行。)

meaning: v. （使）旋轉；紡 n. 旋轉
example: The distant planet spins rapidly on its axis, completing a full turn roughly every twenty-four hours. (這顆遙遠的行星繞著軸快速自轉，大約每二十四小時轉完一圈。)

meaning: n. 全體人員；員工；人事部門
example: All personnel must wear identity badges while working inside the research facility. (所有員工在研究設施內工作時都必須佩戴識別證。)
The doctor warned that heavy drinking could permanently damage his liver and kidneys. (醫生警告，酗酒可能永久損害他的肝臟和腎臟。)
The warning label said the liquid was inflammable, so smoking was banned throughout the area. (警告標籤寫著這種液體易燃，因此整個區域都禁止吸菸。)
The storm badly disfigured the once beautiful coastline, tearing away trees and leaving ugly deep scars in the cliffs. (暴風雨嚴重破壞原本美麗的海岸線，扯走樹木，並在峭壁上留下難看的深痕。)
They surf every morning before work when the waves are still small and clean. (他們每天上班前衝浪，那時浪還小而乾淨。)
He will swear that he locked the door before leaving the office that night. (他發誓離開辦公室前已鎖門。)
The new motorway created constant noise, making it hard for nearby residents to sleep. (新高速公路造成持續噪音，讓附近居民難以入睡。)

meaning: v. 模擬；模仿 n. 啞劇表演；啞劇演員
example: The toddler mimed feeding an elephant, holding an imaginary bucket above his head. (幼童模仿餵大象的動作，將想像中的水桶高舉過頭。)

meaning: v. 強加於；徵（稅等）；處以（罰款等）
example: The city plans to impose a small tax on single-use plastic bags. (這座城市計畫對一次性塑膠袋課徵少量稅金。)
The likelihood of rain increases sharply in the afternoon during the typhoon season. (颱風季期間，午後下雨的可能性大幅增加。)
A gas leak caused the old building to explode shortly after midnight. (瓦斯外洩導致這棟舊建築在午夜過後不久爆炸。)

meaning: adj. 壯觀的；令人驚歎的 n. 壯觀的場面；精彩的表演
example: The mountain road offers spectacular views of the valley and the sea beyond. (這條山路可眺望山谷及遠方海洋的壯觀景色。)

meaning: adj. 巨大的；龐大的；極大的
example: The enormous pressure of exams left many students exhausted before the final week began. (考試的巨大壓力讓許多學生在最後一週開始前就筋疲力盡。)

meaning: adj. 產生相反效果的；適得其反的
example: Punishing employees harshly for honest mistakes is usually counterproductive and reduces trust. (嚴厲懲罰員工的無心之過通常適得其反，還會降低信任。)

meaning: adj. 不同的 n. 變數；變體
example: This variant of the virus spreads more easily but causes milder symptoms. (這種病毒變體傳播得更容易，但引起的症狀較輕。)

meaning: n. 康復；復原 adj. 有治療作用的
example: Clean bandages and rest are essential for the healing of deep wounds. (乾淨的繃帶和休息對深層傷口的癒合至關重要。)
The manager's autocratic style discouraged experienced staff from suggesting any new ideas. (經理專制的作風讓資深員工不敢提出任何新想法。)

meaning: vt. 與……競爭；趕上；模擬；模仿
example: Small local firms hope to emulate the success of the larger technology companies. (小型本地公司希望效法大型科技公司的成功。)

meaning: adj. 損失慘重的；災難性的；極壞的
example: A disastrous harvest left the village short of food for the entire winter. (災難性的歉收讓村莊整個冬天都缺乏食物。)

meaning: v. 倒塌；倒下；打倒；推翻
example: Strong winds toppled several old trees and blocked the main road for hours. (強風吹倒好幾棵老樹，使主要道路阻塞數小時。)

meaning: n. 彈性；復原力；適應性
example: The small community showed remarkable resilience after the earthquake destroyed hundreds of homes. (地震摧毀數百戶住家後，這個小社區展現了驚人的復原力。)

meaning: adj. 並行的；間接的；附帶的
example: The factory closure caused collateral damage to shops and restaurants in the town. (工廠關閉對鎮上的商店和餐廳造成附帶損害。)
A colossal statue of the former leader dominates the entrance to the park. (一座巨大的前領袖雕像矗立在公園入口。)

meaning: v. 對付；處理；搶截 n. 用具
example: The council must tackle the shortage of affordable housing in the city centre. (市議會必須處理市中心平價住房短缺的問題。)

meaning: v. 調整；協調 n. 座標 adj. 同等的
example: Volunteers coordinate transport and temporary accommodation for families fleeing the flooded area. (志工為逃離洪災區的家庭協調交通和臨時住宿。)
The school offers supplementary classes for students who need extra help with mathematics. (學校為數學需要額外幫助的學生開設補充課程。)
The company's accounts came under close scrutiny after the sudden resignation of its director. (董事突然辭職後，公司帳目受到嚴格審查。)
Sleep affects cognition, memory and the ability to concentrate during the day. (睡眠會影響白天的認知、記憶和專注能力。)

meaning: vt. 擊退；驅逐；抵制；使反感
example: This coating repels water, so the jacket stays dry in light rain. (這層塗料能排斥水，因此這件外套在小雨中仍保持乾燥。)

meaning: vt. 馴養；教化；使喜愛家居生活
example: Farmers domesticated wild grasses thousands of years ago to produce reliable grain crops. (數千年前，農民馴化野生禾草，培育出可靠的穀物作物。)
The report provides an exhaustive review of every study published on the subject. (這份報告詳盡回顧了所有已發表於此主題的研究。)
Technicians calibrate the laboratory instruments every month to ensure highly accurate measurements. (技術員每月校準實驗室儀器，以確保測量準確。)
Thick fog descended on the valley, forcing drivers to reduce their speed. (濃霧降下山谷，迫使駕駛減速。)

meaning: n. 邊境；邊界；前沿；新領域
example: The village lies on the frontier between the two countries, beside a wide river. (這座村莊位於兩國邊境，緊鄰一條寬闊的河流。)
The museum's collection of ancient maps is fascinating for both children and adults. (博物館的古代地圖收藏對兒童和成人都很迷人。)

meaning: n. 打擊；中風；筆畫 vt. 撫摸
example: Her grandfather made a full recovery after suffering a mild stroke last spring. (她祖父去年春天輕微中風後完全康復。)
Solar panels on the roof supply most of the building's electricity during summer. (屋頂的太陽能板在夏季提供這棟建築大部分的電力。)
I sympathise with residents who are worried about the noise from the new road. (我同情那些擔心新道路噪音的居民。)
Their music is a fusion of jazz and traditional folk, attracting listeners who rarely enjoy either style alone. (他們的音樂融合爵士與傳統民謠，吸引平常很少單獨喜歡其中任一種風格的聽眾。)

meaning: n. 砍痕；斜線號 v. 砍；削減
example: The company plans to slash its advertising budget by nearly half next year. (公司計畫明年將廣告預算削減近一半。)
Workplace diversity brings different ideas, although it also requires careful communication and mutual respect. (職場多樣性帶來不同想法，但也需要謹慎溝通和彼此尊重。)
Wild bee populations have declined sharply, threatening crops that depend on pollination every spring. (野生蜜蜂數量急遽下降，威脅著每年春天依靠授粉的農作物。)
The city faces a water crisis, and its reservoirs may run dry within months. (這座城市面臨水資源危機，水庫可能幾個月內就會乾涸。)
Only a few of the mushrooms growing in this forest are edible. (這座森林裡生長的蘑菇只有少數可食用。)
The new album was a collaboration between musicians from three different countries. (這張新專輯是來自三個不同國家的音樂家合作的成果。)
It is hard to decouple tourism from environmental damage completely, since visitors inevitably consume large amounts of water and fuel. (很難讓觀光與環境破壞完全脫鉤，因為遊客無可避免會消耗大量水和燃料。)
Each participant was interviewed twice, and those who missed a session were later asked to explain their absence. (每位參加者都接受兩次訪談，缺席某次訪談的人之後會被要求說明缺席原因。)
The long illness seriously weakened his immune system, so even ordinary colds often lasted far longer than they usually do. (長期病痛嚴重削弱他的免疫系統，因此連普通感冒也常比平常持續得久得多。)

meaning: vt. 轉移（注意力）；使分心
example: Loud music in the library distracts students who are trying to revise for exams. (圖書館裡的吵鬧音樂會讓正在準備考試的學生分心。)

meaning: vi. （表示憤怒或煩心而）皺眉 n. 皺眉
example: The teacher frowned at the careless answer, then asked the pupil to explain his reasoning. (老師對粗心的答案皺了皺眉，接著請學生解釋自己的推理。)

meaning: vt. 使偏；曲解 adj. 歪斜的
example: Online surveys can easily skew results, because they mostly reach people with very strong opinions and reliable internet. (網路調查很容易使結果偏差，因為它們主要觸及意見強烈且網路穩定的人。)
She lost one warm glove on the train, and the kind station staff found it the next morning. (她在火車上掉了一隻保暖手套，親切的車站人員隔天早上找到了。)
The beekeeper carefully moved the old wooden beehive, protecting the queen and keeping the colony calm. (養蜂人小心移動舊木蜂箱，保護蜂王並讓蜂群保持平靜。)

meaning: adv. 迷路地；誤入歧途地
example: The hikers went astray in the fog and were found hours later. (登山客在霧中迷路，數小時後才被找到。)

meaning: n. 理論；原理；學說；看法
example: The theory sounds fully convincing, yet no single experiment has ever produced evidence strong enough to support it. (這個理論聽起來完全有說服力，但從沒有任何單一實驗產生足以支持它的證據。)
The team's main weakness is defence, so opponents score easily when they attack from the left. (這支球隊的主要弱點是防守，因此對手從左路進攻時很容易得分。)

meaning: n. 部分；一份 vt. 劃分；分配
example: A large portion of the budget was spent on repairing the old bridge. (預算的一大部分花在修復那座舊橋上。)

meaning: vt. 使惡化 n. 化合物；樓群 adj. 複合的
example: An old knee injury compounded his financial troubles, since he could not work for several months. (舊膝傷使他的財務困境雪上加霜，因為他有好幾個月無法工作。)

meaning: n. 跨距；一段時間 v. 橫跨；持續
example: The new bridge will span the river and connect the two fishing villages. (新橋將橫跨河流，連接兩個漁村。)
The hotel has only one vacancy left for the busy holiday weekend. (繁忙的連假週末，這家飯店只剩一個空房。)
The plant grows well in this locality because the soil is damp and shaded. (這種植物在這個地區長得很好，因為土壤潮溼且有遮蔭。)

meaning: n. 圓；環狀物；圈子 v. 圈出
example: A circle of white stones still marks the ancient meeting place high on the hill. (一圈白色石頭仍標示著山丘高處的古老集會場所。)
The accuracy of the weather forecast has improved greatly over the past decade. (過去十年來，天氣預報的準確性大幅提升。)
The plant can tolerate very dry conditions but still needs plenty of sunlight. (這種植物能忍受非常乾燥的環境，但仍需要充足陽光。)

meaning: v. 負擔得起；提供；給予
example: Many local fans could not afford the expensive concert tickets, so the band added a free outdoor show for them. (許多當地歌迷負擔不起昂貴的演唱會門票，因此樂團為他們加開一場免費戶外演出。)

meaning: adj. 極好的；傑出的；優秀的
example: Her excellent final exam results surprised everyone, since she had missed several weeks of school through illness. (她期末考成績優異，讓大家驚訝，因為她因病缺課好幾週。)

meaning: v. 連接；銜接；聯合；聯想到
example: The new cable finally connects the remote village to fast internet, helping local students study online after school. (新電纜終於把偏遠村莊連上高速網路，幫助當地學生放學後線上學習。)
The engine has four cylinders, each fitted with a small fuel injector. (這具引擎有四個汽缸，每個都裝有小型噴油嘴。)
The main disadvantage of the flat is its distance from public transport. (這間公寓的主要缺點是離大眾運輸很遠。)
Residents were invited to participate in planning the new local park, and their suggestions shaped the final design. (居民受邀參與規劃新公園，他們的建議塑造了最終設計。)

meaning: n. 原則；原理；規範；信念
example: The design follows the principle that natural light should reach every room. (這項設計遵循讓自然光照進每個房間的原則。)
Light refreshments will be served in the garden after the graduation ceremony. (畢業典禮後，花園裡會提供簡單茶點。)
Relations between the two countries deteriorated rapidly, although trade continued throughout the dispute. (兩國關係迅速惡化，儘管爭端期間雙邊貿易仍持續進行。)
The scorching afternoon sun made the metal playground too hot to touch. (酷熱的午後陽光讓金屬遊樂設施燙得無法觸摸。)

meaning: n. 其時 adv. 同時；當時
example: The bridge is closed; in the meantime, buses will take a longer route. (橋梁封閉，在此期間公車將改走較長路線。)
According to a local campaign group, the new flats would ruin the historic townscape. (當地一個倡議團體表示，新公寓將破壞歷史悠久的市鎮風貌。)

meaning: adj. 上面的；地位較高的
example: The strict upper limit for checked luggage is twenty kilograms, and passengers must pay extra for anything heavier. (托運行李的嚴格上限是二十公斤，超過的部分乘客必須額外付費。)

meaning: adj. 清白的；無害的；天真的
example: The court released the man after new evidence proved he was innocent. (新證據證明男子清白後，法院將他釋放。)
The course places great emphasis on speaking and listening rather than grammar rules. (這門課非常強調聽說能力，而非文法規則。)

meaning: v. 靠近；接近 n. 方法；途徑
example: Their approach to the problem was refreshingly practical, focusing on small everyday changes rather than costly complete redesigns. (他們處理這個問題的方法實際得令人耳目一新，著重日常小改變而非昂貴的全面重新設計。)

meaning: n. 持續；持續時間；期間
example: Visitors must remain seated for the duration of the thirty-minute film. (三十分鐘的影片播放期間，訪客必須保持就座。)

meaning: adv. 首先；主要地；首要地
example: The scheme is funded primarily by local businesses rather than the government. (這項計畫主要由當地企業資助，而非政府。)

meaning: adj. 到期的；預期的；應得的；正當的
example: The borrowed library book is due back on Friday, but she has not quite finished reading it yet. (借來的圖書館書週五到期，但她還沒完全讀完。)

meaning: adj. 熱衷的；渴望的；敏銳的；激烈的
example: She is keen to learn new skills and rarely turns down extra work. (她熱衷學習新技能，很少拒絕額外工作。)
A small worm crawled across the wet path after the heavy rain. (大雨過後，一條小蟲爬過潮溼的小徑。)

meaning: adj. 硬的；僵硬的 adv. 極其；非常
example: My neck felt stiff after sleeping on the narrow train seat. (睡在狹窄的火車座位上後，我的脖子僵硬不適。)
The cabin was built from local timber and insulated with sheep's wool. (這間小屋用當地木材建造，並以羊毛隔熱。)

meaning: adj. 深切的；深遠的；深奧的
example: The war had a profound effect on the way the village celebrated festivals. (戰爭對這個村莊慶祝節日的方式產生深遠影響。)

meaning: n. 新聞工作者；新聞記者
example: The young journalist spent three weeks interviewing families affected by the factory closure. (這位年輕記者花了三週採訪受工廠關閉影響的家庭。)
They needed written permission to film on the beach, and the council replied only after two weeks. (他們需要書面許可才能在海灘拍攝，而市議會兩週後才回覆。)
